entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Avoid modifying commands in help writer #52136
  • [failing test] Microsoft.NET.Build.Tests.GivenThatWeWantToBuildAWindowsRuntimeComponent.ManagedWinRTComponentCanBeReferenced #52131
  • Add test counts to per-assembly summaries #52128
  • Cannot run .NET 10 SDK dotnet test with an argument containing a colon using System.Diagnostics.Process #52127
  • NuGet.Build.Tasks.Pack.targets file lock prevents .nupkg access during dotnet publish #52126

Closed

  • Fix TODO in CannotAddOrRemoveVirtualKeyword #52129
  • Specifying extremely long filters (dotnet test --filter ...) doesn't work #14465
  • .NET 10 SDK dotnet clean does not remove packages produced by multi-TFM projects #52109
  • `dotnet test` mtp is buggy with platforms #52106
  • dotnet run app.cs doesn't detect changes in referenced project #52057
    10.0.2xx
  • Passing a filename as an argument using the `dotnet App.cs` command isn’t working. #52108
    10.0.2xx
  • `dotnet run file.cs` doesn't detect changes through alias #52063
    10.0.2xx
  • with 5.0 sdk, dotnet build fails for a project already restored by an older sdk #14347
    Discussion
  • Could not load file or assembly 'System.Private.ServiceModel, Version=4.1.2.0 #14331
    Discussion

PullRequests

Created

  • Refactor Tool and Workload command subcommands - separate parsing and action logic #52140
  • Separate command parsing from action binding in Tool and Workload subcommands #52139
  • Completion #52137
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52135
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix interaction of "csc only after msbuild" optimization and implicit build files #52133
    Area-run-file
  • Clarify some aspects of `dotnet run -` #52132
    Area-run-file
  • [template engine cli] Remove dependency on filter definitions from command definitions #52124
  • Add a BenchmarkDotNet project #52123

Merged

  • [dotnet-run] fix logging and `Restore` for device selection #52113
  • Remove obsolete TODO referencing resolved issue #26169 #52130
  • create a tasks-focused solution filter, and make repo tests more usable in VSCode #52072
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Update ManagedWinRTComponentCanBeReferenced test to Windows SDK 10.0.26100.0 #52134
  • Skip up-to-date optimization in dotnet-run-file when there are `#:project` directives #52062
    Area-run-file
  • Fix dotnet-run-file up-to-date checks across symlinks #52064
    Area-run-file
  • Avoid discarding file-like arguments in `dotnet file.cs` invocations #52110
    Area-run-file
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #52096
    Area-VMR

Updated

  • [Backport][10.0.1xx] Add suppressor support for `dotnet format` #51997
    Servicing-consider, 10.0.3
  • Add trailing slash for -o Fixes #45682 #48640
    untriaged, Area-CLI
  • Add APICompat rule to detect static keyword changes on members and types #52112
  • Virtual project builder #52030
  • Add Executable launch profile support to dotnet run and dotnet watch #51727
    Partner request, Document for new feature, Area-Run, 10.0.2xx
  • [dotnet-run] Implement `DeployToDevice` target invocation #52046
  • Add 'Eliminate Duplicate SDK Files' one-pager #51886
  • Allow easier overriding of crossgen tasks/targets #52021
  • Preserve file encoding in file-based app source files #52055
    Area-run-file
  • Stop Format redistributing MSBuild #49065
    Area-CodeFlow, stale
  • [dotnet-watch] Simplify logging #51307
  • Move definitions to Microsoft.DotNet.Cli.Definitions #52120
  • Add GitHub Actions workflows to automate XLF updates and completion test fixes #51158
  • Add -ResetToTargetPaths parameter to github-merge-flow.jsonc #52000
